decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API sits close to the established messaging offer and has kept its own page for two years, so results appear to meet aspiration in a growing industry, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product at low marginal cost.
The email-to-SMS gateway is a recent, low-cost extension of the core secure communication platform with no sign of a shortfall, so management has no trigger for problemistic search and keeps it.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B and the existing channels, and with only one year on the market and ample slack, management tolerates uncertain early results rather than dropping it.
